text: Kingsmoor FC pushes forward on the right flank near Westport Albion’s penalty area, maintaining possession with short, precise passes. Their wide midfielders advance along both flanks, delivering crosses into the box close to Westport Albion’s goal at the southern end. Westport Albion defends deeper, allowing Kingsmoor to control the midfield and edges of the penalty area, though Westport’s compact shape limits clear shot opportunities. Kingsmoor’s Viktor Quinlan takes a low shot from the edge of the final third on the left side, but it goes off target[#1034].
